_doc: Bag definitions (owner spec 31, durango-prompts/31_bag_levels_quality_and_capacity.md). A bag ITEM lives in items.json with categories accessory+bag and a bag_def pointing here; this file holds only its storage definition. HISTORICAL (spec 31 §1, §5, §15): a survivor starts with 100 personal spaces; a worn item's Pocket attribute adds 6 spaces per level. ASSUMPTION (spec 31 §2, §15 explicitly allows illustrative curves and new recipes): every capacity_curve table, storage_bonus and recipe below is a new design value, not a Nexon one. capacity_curve is [level, base_capacity] rows, linearly interpolated and clamped at both ends: a bag's level and its capacity bonus are separate statistics (a level-60 bag does not add 60). inheritable lists the material attributes this bag type may carry over from its primary material; anything else on the material stays on the material. storage_attributes maps an inherited attribute key to the spaces ONE point of it is worth to this bag. Read by scripts/items/bag_def.gd.
